title: 2.7.5 Updates
message:
• Now, you can receive in-app updates! Like this.
• Added **Send Feedback** button in Settings.
• Join our [Reddit community](https://www.reddit.com/r/DigitalStickyNotesApp/)!
• Now your deleted notes are safe for some time in the Recycle Bin.

title: 2.7.4 Performance & Rendering Boost
message:
• Smoother canvas scrolling on high refresh rate displays (90Hz / 120Hz).

message:
• Added smoother gesture response when zooming out on large walls.

message:

message:
